title: Beauty, Symmetry, and Magnetocaloric Effect—Four-Shell Keplerates with 104 Lanthanide Atoms

synthesis.procedure: Reported as self-assembling upon hydrolysis of a mixture of neodymium perchlorate, cobalt(II) acetate tetrahydrate, and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine. The main article does not provide reagent quantities or a complete preparation procedure.
synthesis.temperature: 95 °C for the sealed reaction; cooled to 30 °C at 3 °C h⁻¹
synthesis.time: 2 h at 95 °C; crystals obtained after 5 days of standing and evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The reaction was cooled to 30 °C; violet block-shaped crystals formed after standing and evaporation of the filtrate in an oven at 30 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Nd104 core has nested Nd8@Nd48@Nd24@Nd24 shells: an inner cube, then a truncated cuboctahedron, truncated octahedron, and rhombicuboctahedron. The article describes the cage in terms of square-pyramidal Nd5 units forming Nd16 wheels, linked by eight additional Nd-centered hydroxo units; this is a structural decomposition, not an observed synthetic sequence.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Reported as isostructural with 1, with a four-shell Nd8@Nd48@Nd24@Nd24 metal arrangement: a cube nested within a truncated cuboctahedron, truncated octahedron, and rhombicuboctahedron. The detailed building-unit discussion and Figures 1–3 depict compound 1 rather than an independently illustrated structure of 2.

synthesis.procedure: Reported as self-assembling upon hydrolysis of a mixture of gadolinium perchlorate, cobalt(II) acetate tetrahydrate, and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine. The main article does not provide reagent quantities or a complete preparation procedure.
synthesis.temperature: NaOH added at 70 °C; mixture then refluxed; filtrate held at 30 °C
synthesis.time: 2 h at reflux; 5 days of standing and evaporation, following the procedure for compound 2
synthesis.vessel_or_method: NaOH added dropwise with stirring at 70 °C, followed by reflux, as for compound 2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Following the procedure for compound 2, the mixture was filtered while hot and the filtrate stood and evaporated in an oven at 30 °C; colorless block-shaped crystals were obtained.

properties.summary: The susceptibility trend indicates dominant antiferromagnetic interactions between Gd(III) ions. Magnetization and heat-capacity measurements give a large magnetocaloric effect, with mutually consistent magnetic entropy changes for a 7 T field change at 2 K.
